name: Pachamama

domain_history.domain: earth-mother figure, fertility and agricultural abundance

continuing, living contemporary practice: annual challa offering ritual (August 1st) across the Andes; documented syncretism with Catholic Mass (Cusco, El Alto); adopted as a symbol in contemporary environmental activism and Indigenous-rights movements

notes: Genuinely LIVING, not solely ancient/historical practice — a documented parallel to how the Yolŋu Elcho Island adjustment movement and the Haudenosaunee Longhouse Religion show Indigenous religious traditions in this dataset are not confined to the past.
